name: Valle de Abdalajís (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valle de Abdalajís (a castle on red).
history: Municipal flag of Valle de Abdalajís; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valle de Abdalajís arms — castle on red
castle and crown of the arms
